title: The Format is the Filter: Scoring Format Fixes What an LLM Judge Can Express
title_zh: 格式即过滤器：评分格式决定了 LLM 评判者所能表达的内容

paragraphs.en: When an LLM judge filters instruction-tuning data, its scoring format (binary verdict, 1–5 rating, 0–100 score, or comparison) is rarely justified or ablated. Holding the candidate pool, judge prompt, decoding and selection budget fixed, we score 15,406 UltraFeedback candidates under five formats with three judges, curate, fine-tune 66 models, and evaluate them with four judges. A 0–100 scale is worth only 7–12 equally used levels, two to three times a 1–5 scale rather than twenty, and a binary verdict leaves the top score tied in 77–78% of prompts, so most selections are made at random. These properties are set by the format almost independently of the judge. Kendall’s τ b \tau_{b} hides them: it ranks binary best while τ a \tau_{a} and top-1 agreement rank it last, because it discounts the ties a selector must break at random. Both comparative formats inherit a slot bias whose sign differs across judges. Downstream, curated data beat random selection under every evaluation judge, robust to length and markdown adjustment, but no ordering among formats is detectable. We propose four quantities that judge-based curation pipelines should report.

paragraphs.en: A practitioner assembling an instruction-tuning corpus without an annotation budget typically asks an LLM judge to score every candidate, keeps the top fraction, and fine-tunes on what survives ( Zheng et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Sachdeva et al., 2026 ) . How to ask for the judge’s opinion (ACCEPT/REJECT, a 1–5 rating, a 0–100 score, a comparison) is usually decided once, on grounds of convenience, and rarely ablated with the selector held fixed. Yet a curation pipeline consumes scores as an ordering and breaks ties at random, so tie structure is a first-class property of a format: a binary verdict leaves every accepted candidate indistinguishable, and the choice at the frontier is made by chance.
paragraphs.zh: 在没有标注预算的情况下，构建指令微调语料库的实践者通常会请一个 LLM 裁判为每个候选项打分，保留得分最高的部分，并对保留下来的内容进行微调（Zheng et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Sachdeva et al., 2026）。 如何征求裁判的意见（接受/拒绝、1–5 分评级、0–100 分评分或比较）通常只需根据便利性一次性决定，并且很少在保持选择器不变的情况下进行消融分析。 然而，整理流程会将分数用作排序依据，并以随机方式打破平局，因此平局结构是某种格式的一级属性：二元裁决会使所有被接受的候选项无法区分，而边界处的选择则由偶然性决定。

paragraphs.en: We vary only the format across five designs, score a fixed pool with three judges, and follow one judge’s scores through curation and LoRA fine-tuning to 66 models. Our main contributions are as follows: (i) a fully crossed study of three judges × \times five formats, showing that the format, not the judge, determines how many ties the scores contain, a result that holds when any one judge is left out and when each format’s number of available levels is taken into account (§ 3.1 ); (ii) evidence that τ b \tau_{b} inverts the ordering a selection audit needs (§ 3.3 ); (iii) evidence that both comparative formats inherit a judge-specific slot bias, measured three ways (§ 3.4 ); and (iv) downstream results under four evaluation judges (§ 4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们在五种设计中仅改变格式，用三名评委对固定的作品池进行评分，并在策展和 LoRA 微调至 66 个模型的过程中沿用其中一名评委的评分。 我们的主要贡献如下：(i) 对三名评委 × 五种格式进行了全面交叉研究，结果表明决定评分中平局数量的是格式而非评委；这一结论在排除任意一名评委以及考虑每种格式可用等级数量时依然成立（§ 3.1）；(ii) 证据表明 τ b \tau_{b} 会逆转选择审计所需的排序（§ 3.3）；(iii) 证据表明两种比较性格式都继承了特定于评委的槽位偏差，并通过三种方式进行了测量（§ 3.4）；以及 (iv) 在四名评估评委下的下游结果（§ 4）。

paragraphs.en: Elicitation studies measure formats by agreement with human or reference ratings ( Li et al., 2026 ; Novikova et al., 2018 ; Zhuang et al., 2024 ) or compare pointwise and pairwise protocols for bias ( Tripathi et al., 2025 ) , without following scores into training. Data-selection work does follow them, but with one elicitation protocol ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Cui et al., 2023 ; Pang et al., 2025 ; Wettig et al., 2024 ) . Deutsch et al. (2023) establish that ties distort Kendall-style meta-evaluation; we show the consequence for selection. Configuration beyond the judge model is a known variance source ( Zhang, 2026 ; Don-Yehiya et al., 2026 ; Norman et al., 2026 ; Soumik, 2026 ) . We add the controlled format ablation, carried through to trained models.
paragraphs.zh: 信息提取研究通过与人或参考评分的一致性来评估不同格式（Li et al., 2026; Novikova et al., 2018; Zhuang et al., 2024），或比较点式与成对协议在偏差方面的表现（Tripathi et al., 2025），但并未将这些评分纳入训练。 数据选择研究确实遵循了这些方法，但仅采用了一种信息提取协议（Chen et al., 2024; Cui et al., 2023; Pang et al., 2025; Wettig et al., 2024）。Deutsch et al. （2023）指出，平局会扭曲肯德尔风格的元评估；我们则展示了这种影响对数据选择的具体后果。 超出评判者模型范围的配置是已知的变异来源（Zhang, 2026; Don-Yehiya et al., 2026; Norman et al., 2026; Soumik, 2026）。 我们进一步加入了受控的格式消融分析，并将其贯穿至训练模型的全过程。

paragraphs.en: We draw 4,000 UltraFeedback prompts ( Cui et al., 2023 ) , yielding 15,406 multi-model responses after a 20–6,000 character filter ( k ¯ = 3.85 \bar{k}=3.85 per prompt); 300 further prompts are held out. UltraFeedback’s GPT-4 scores are used as the reference . They never enter a prompt as numbers, the selection decision, or the training data, but they choose the anchor in the anchored format and the evaluation reference, so we report agreement with the GPT-4 reference and avoid the term accuracy.

paragraphs.en: The pointwise formats share one preamble (helpfulness, correctness, completeness, clarity) and differ only in the final instruction; the comparative formats use a parallel pairwise prompt with five verdicts mapped to v ∈ { + 2 , … , − 2 } v\in\{+2,\dots,-2\} (Appendix A ). Binary (ACCEPT/REJECT → { 0 , 1 } \to\{0,1\} ), Likert-5 ( ( v − 1 ) / 4 (v-1)/4 ) and Numeric-100 ( v / 100 v/100 ) are pointwise. Anchored compares the candidate (always Response A) with a fixed per-prompt anchor, the upper-middle candidate by GPT-4 score ( Don-Yehiya et al., 2026 ) . Tournament compares every pair of candidates within a prompt once. Each verdict v v gives Response A a win probability σ ⁡ ( v ) = 1 / ( 1 + e − v ) \sigma(v)=1/(1+e^{-v}) (0.88 for a strong win, 0.5 for a tie), and a candidate’s score is its average win probability over its matches, a soft win rate. Decoding is greedy, with a 16-token verdict budget and reasoning disabled. Selection uses within-format ranks, which preserve ties, so each format’s tie structure passes unchanged into selection.
paragraphs.zh: 逐点格式共享一个前导部分（帮助性、正确性、完整性、清晰度），仅最终指令不同；比较格式则使用平行的成对提示，包含五个判定值，映射到 v ∈ { +2 , … , − 2 }（附录 A）。 二元（接受/拒绝 → { 0 , 1 }）、Likert-5（ (v−1)/4 ）和 Numeric-100（ v / 100 ）均为逐点格式。 锚定比较将候选项（始终为响应 A）与每个提示中固定的锚定项进行比较，该锚定项由 GPT-4 得分确定的上中部候选项（Don-Yehiya 等人，2026）。 锦标赛格式在单个提示内对每对候选项进行一次比较。 每个判定值 v 赋予响应 A 一个获胜概率 σ(v) = 1 / (1 + e^{-v})（强胜为 0.88，平局为 0.5），候选项的得分为其在所有匹配中的平均获胜概率，即软胜率。 解码采用贪心策略，判定值预算为 16 个词元，且禁用推理。 选择过程使用格式内部的排名，该排名保留平局关系，因此每种格式的平局结构在转入选择时保持不变。

paragraphs.en: Three curation judges score the identical pool: deepseek-v4-flash ( DeepSeek-AI et al., 2026 ) , qwen3.5-9b ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , and nemotron-3-nano-30b-a3b ; parse rates are ≥ 0.998 \geq 0.998 in all fifteen cells. Curation uses DeepSeek scores only. At retention r ∈ { 10 , 25 , 50 } % r\in\{10,25,50\}\% we keep the highest-scored response per prompt (ties broken at random), then the top r r of these globally. paragraphs.en: By τ b \tau_{b} , binary is the best format under DeepSeek and Nemotron and second under Qwen; by τ a \tau_{a} it is last under DeepSeek and Qwen. τ a \tau_{a} , Somers’ D D and top-1 agreement all rank numeric-100 first, Likert-5 second and binary last under DeepSeek and Qwen, differing only on anchored versus tournament. τ b \tau_{b} ( Kendall, 1945 ) divides by ( n 0 − n 1 ) ​ ( n 0 − n 2 ) \sqrt{(n_{0}-n_{1})(n_{0}-n_{2})} , where n 1 n_{1} counts judge-tied pairs, so coarse formats are divided by a smaller number. When the reference orders a pair strictly and the judge ties it, the selector breaks the tie at random, so the pair’s expected concordance is zero, which is how τ a \tau_{a} scores it and not how τ b \tau_{b} does. For example, with reference order a > b > c a>b>c and a binary judge accepting a , b a,b , τ a = 2 / 3 \tau_{a}=2/3 and τ b ≈ 0.82 \tau_{b}\approx 0.82 , yet the selector picks a a only half the time. This is the common case here: binary leaves the top score tied in 77–78% of prompts (TT in Table 1 ), against 40–47% for numeric-100. The argument extends Deutsch et al. (2023) from meta-evaluation to selection.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 τ b \tau_{b} 而言，在 DeepSeek 和 Nemotron 中，二元格式是最佳格式，在 Qwen 中则排名第二；而对于 τ a \tau_{a} 而言，它在 DeepSeek 和 Qwen 中均排名最后。就 τ a \tau_{a}、Somers’ D D 和 top-1 一致性而言，在 DeepSeek 和 Qwen 中，numeric-100 的排名均为第一，Likert-5 为第二，二元格式则排名最后，二者仅在有锚点与锦标赛两种设定上存在差异。τ b \tau_{b}（Kendall, 1945）的分母为 (n_{0}-n_{1})(n_{0}-n_{2}) 的平方根，其中 n_{1} 表示评分者打平的对数，因此粗略格式的分母较小。当参考排序严格区分一对样本，而评分者却将其视为打平时，选择器会随机打破平局，因此该对样本的预期一致性为零，这也是 τ a \tau_{a} 的评分方式，而非 τ b \tau_{b} 的方式。例如，若参考排序为 a > b > c，而二元评分者接受 a 和 b，则 τ a = 2/3，τ b ≈ 0.82，但选择器仅有一半的概率会选择 a。这种情况在此处十分常见：在提示中，77%–78% 的情况下，二元格式会导致最高分出现平局（见表 1 中的 TT），而 numeric-100 的情况则为 40%–47%。这一论证将 Deutsch 等人（2023）的研究从元评估扩展到了选择领域。

paragraphs.en: Read each comparative verdict as a margin in favor of Response A. A genuine preference for the candidate follows the candidate, so its sign flips when the candidate moves from slot A to slot B; a preference for a slot does not move. Running 500 anchored candidates per judge in both orders therefore gives v fwd = q + b v_{\text{fwd}}=q+b and v rev = − q + b v_{\text{rev}}=-q+b , separating the mean preference for the candidate q q from the slot-A bias b b (Table 4 , Appendix B ). The bias differs in sign on identical inputs: b = − 0.33 b=-0.33 ( ± 0.09 \pm 0.09 ) for DeepSeek and Qwen, toward slot B, and + 0.89 +0.89 [ 0.79 0.79 , 0.99 0.99 ] for Nemotron. Self-comparisons confirm it without the additive model: the anchor is one of the candidates, so 4,000 queries compare a response with itself, where any verdict other than TIE can only reflect position. paragraphs.en: Decoding. All verdicts use greedy decoding. Probability-weighted scores (e.g., the expected Likert value under the verdict-token distribution, as in G-Eval; Liu et al., 2023 ) or repeated sampling would make binary and Likert-5 effectively continuous. Our structural results describe format together with greedy decoding, not format alone. Variance decomposition. There is one observation per cell, so the residual absorbs the format × \times judge interaction; three judges give the judge factor two degrees of freedom, and the judge share in reference agreement is driven by one judge (Table 2 ). Reference. Agreement is measured against UltraFeedback’s GPT-4 scores, not human labels. The same scores choose the anchor shown to the judge in the anchored format and the evaluation reference. Downstream design. Training data come from one curation judge (DeepSeek), so we do not test whether a less accurate curation judge yields worse students; one Nemotron-curated condition would. We have no untuned student or GPT-4-oracle selector baseline, so we cannot say whether better reference agreement yields better training data. Our length and markdown adjustment conditions on properties of the trained model’s own outputs, so it is a sensitivity check rather than a causal control. The Length baseline is confounded with truncation (the 1,024-token cap removes 11.4–25.2% of its examples against 1.8–6.2% elsewhere). Format-specific confounds. Binary’s disadvantage is inseparable from its random tie-breaking. Anchored is intentionally unswapped, and 26% of its queries compare the anchor with itself, which assigns every anchor the same score. The tournament’s slot assignment follows listing order, so its selections, including the DeepSeek-curated training data, carry each judge’s slot bias; its soft win rate is computed within small slates ( k ¯ = 3.85 \bar{k}=3.85 ), so a weak slate’s winner can score as high as a strong slate’s. Scope. We only use one candidate pool, one student, and one language.
